decisions.rationale: Lead Mamoswine+Gengar-Mega for offense+Shadow Tag trapping. Gengar-Mega immune to Sneasler Close Combat, resists Gardevoir-Mega Fairy. Mamoswine Focus Sash+Ice Shard for priority picks and Gardevoir MU. Gyarados back for Intimidate vs physical attackers, Taunt for TR, resists Fairy. Corviknight back for Tailwind (not blocked by Armor Tail), Brave Bird SE on Sneasler, Steel resists Fairy, Mirror Armor ignores Intimidate. Drop Klefki (Prankster blocked by Armor Tail) and Skeledirge (poor MU, too slow).
decisions.notebook: Series fc67bc1662f2; game 2 lead: Mamoswine+Gengar-Mega, back Gyarados+Corviknight. Dropped Klefki (Prankster TWave blocked by Farigiraf Armor Tail) and Skeledirge (poor MU). Key threats: Sneasler Unburden 2x Speed after Focus Sash consumption — Gengar-Mega Ghost immunity blocks Close Combat but ThroatChop hits 2x. Farigiraf Armor Tail blocks ALL priority targeting its side (Ice Shard, Prankster). Tailwind from Corviknight is non-priority speed control that bypasses Armor Tail. Gengar-Mega raw Speed 165-200, Sneasler 154-189 pre-Unburden. Watch for opponent adjusting to Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate Hyper Voice spread) or Skarmory (Tailwind+Sturdy wall). Gyarados and Corviknight both resist Fairy for Gardevoir-Mega MU. If opponent leads Farigiraf+Sneasler, priority is blocked — rely on raw speed and Gengar Taunt to prevent TR.

decisions.rationale: Lead Incineroar+Fari: Fake Out Gyarados to stop its Taunt while Farigiraf sets Trick Room safely; Intimidate softens Gyarados/Mamoswine. Back Sneasler (Rock Slide answers Gyarados, outspeeds outside TR) and Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate Hyper Voice) as breakers. This counters their aggressive Gyarados/Mamoswine lead and keeps TR control.
decisions.notebook: Opponent: Gyarados Jolly Intimidate Sitrus Waterfall/Taunt/Crunch/Protect, outspeeds Incineroar outside TR, survives resisted Flare Blitz. Mamoswine Adamant ThickFat FocusSash IceShard/IcicleCrash/HighHorsepower/Protect. Skeledirge Modest Unaware Lum TorchSong/Wisp/ShadowBall/Protect. Gengar-Mega Timid Gengarite ShadowBall/SludgeBomb/Taunt/Protect (Shadow Tag). Unused: Corviknight MirrorArmor Leftovers BraveBird/Tailwind/Uturn/Protect; Klefki Prankster LightClay TW/Reflect/LightScreen/Protect. Opponent Protects Mamoswine/Gyarados, brings Gyarados to Intimidate. Plan: Fake Out Gyarados + set TR with Farigiraf; Sneasler Rock Slide is Gyarados answer; keep TR up or outspeed; never close with Incineroar alone. Watch Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag trapping and Klefki TW/screens.

decisions.rationale: Mamoswine Protects to block Incineroar Fake Out (priority +3 would flinch Mamo otherwise), wasting their one-time Fake Out. Gengar Mega Evolves (Shadow Tag traps both foes) and Taunts Farigiraf before it can Trick Room (Gengar-Mega 165-200 Spe vs Farigiraf 80-112). Next turn Fake Out is spent, TR is blocked, and opponent can't switch out. Risk: Farigiraf Psychic could OHKO Gengar-Mega (61-139%), but standard TR lead plays Trick Room turn 1.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Led Mamoswine+Gengar-Mega vs Incineroar+Farigiraf. Opponent back: Gardevoir-Mega, Sneasler (FocusSash/Unburden), Dedenne, Skarmory. Key: Farigiraf Armor Tail blocks ALL priority targeting its side (Ice Shard useless while Farigiraf active). Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag traps non-Ghost foes — trap Incineroar/Farigiraf to prevent TR setup pivot. Farigiraf Psychic is 2x SE on Gengar-Mega, possible OHKO (61-139%) — must respect this threat. Incineroar Fake Out only works turn 1 it's active. Plan: deny TR with Taunt, then pick off trapped foes. Gyarados+Corviknight in back for Gardevoir-Mega/Sneasler MUs (both resist Fairy). Tailwind from Corviknight bypasses Armor Tail for speed control. Sneasler Unburden 2x Speed after sash — Gengar-Mega Ghost blocks Close Combat but ThroatChop hits 2x.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Incineroar)
decisions.rationale: Fake Out flinches Mamoswine (priority +3 beats its High Horsepower), preventing the 2x Ground hit on Incineroar; Armor Tail also blanks its Ice Shard. Farigiraf sets Trick Room to flip speed vs Gengar-Mega/Mamoswine. If Gengar Taunts to deny TR, Mamoswine is still flinched and we pivot via Parting Shot next turn; if it attacks, TR is up and we control pace.
decisions.notebook: Opponent led Mamoswine+Gengar (not Gyarados as earlier planned); Gengar carries Taunt to answer Trick Room and Megas to Shadow Tag (traps Farigiraf). Open sheets mean they know Farigiraf has TR, so expect Taunt on it. Mamoswine Adamant ThickFat FocusSash IceShard/IcicleCrash/HighHorsepower/Protect; its Ice Shard is nullified by Armor Tail while Farigiraf is active. Gengar-Mega Timid Gengarite ShadowBall/SludgeBomb/Taunt/Protect. Plan: keep TR up or outspeed; Sneasler Rock Slide answers Gyarados; never close with Incineroar alone; watch Shadow Tag trap on Farigiraf and Klefki screens/TW.

decisions.rationale: Gengar Protects to dodge Farigiraf's Psychic (55-156%, possible OHKO). Mamoswine High Horsepower hits Incineroar 2x SE for 45-102% even at -1 Atk. If Incineroar Flare Blitzes Mamoswine, Focus Sash saves it at 1HP. Shadow Tag traps both foes; Farigiraf still Taunted. Next turn: finish Incineroar, then pressure Farigiraf.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Shadow Tag traps Incineroar+Farigiraf (neither Ghost). Farigiraf Taunted through turn 3 (used turn 1). Farigiraf Psychic threatens Gengar OHKO (55-156%) — always respect. Incineroar Flare Blitz OHKOs Mamoswine but Focus Sash saves it. Mamoswine High Horsepower at -1 Atk does 45-102% to Incineroar. Plan: Protect Gengar from Psychic, chip Incineroar to KO range, then clean up Farigiraf (Taunt prevents TR/Protect). Backline Gyarados+Corviknight for Gardevoir-Mega/Sneasler. Sneasler Unburden 2x Speed after sash activation — Gengar Ghost resists Close Combat but ThroatChop is 2x. Corviknight Tailwind bypasses Armor Tail for speed control.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf is Taunted (through turn 3) and trapped by Gengar-Mega's Shadow Tag, so it must attack; Psychic into Gengar-Mega is 2x (62-143%, possible OHKO). Incineroar is also trapped but Parting Shot bypasses trapping: weaken Gengar's SpA and bring in Gardevoir, whose Moonblast/Psyshock threaten Gengar (Sneasler's Close Combat is Ghost-immune). This improves board while Farigiraf pressures the main threat.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega (Timid, Gengarite) Megas to Shadow Tag and carries Taunt; it Taunted Farigiraf turn 1, so Farigiraf cannot use Trick Room/Protect until Taunt expires (through turn 3). Sneasler's Close Combat is immune vs Ghost/Poison Gengar-Mega; Gardevoir's Moonblast/Psyshock are 2x on it, so Gardevoir is the better Parting Shot target. Mamoswine Adamant ThickFat FocusSash IceShard/IcicleCrash/HighHorsepower/Protect; its Ice Shard is nullified by Armor Tail while Farigiraf is active. Bench: Gyarados Jolly Intimidate Sitrus Waterfall/Taunt/Crunch/Protect (outspeeds Incineroar outside TR); Skeledirge Modest Unaware Lum TorchSong/Wisp/ShadowBall/Protect; Corviknight MirrorArmor Leftovers BraveBird/Tailwind/Uturn/Protect; Klefki Prankster LightClay TW/Reflect/LightScreen/Protect. Plan: keep Farigiraf alive to set TR once Taunt clears; use Gardevoir to answer Gengar; Sneasler Rock Slide answers Gyarados; watch Klefki screens/TW and Gyarados Intimidate.

decisions.rationale: High Horsepower guaranteed KOs Incineroar (45.5-102.4% vs 42% HP). Switching Gengar to Gyarados preserves Gengar at 100% for later Shadow Tag re-entry; Gyarados absorbs Farigiraf Psychic (17.8-58.8%, survives easily, Sitrus if <50%). Shadow Tag still active during switch phase so foe can't switch this turn. Gyarados (Spe 130) can Taunt Farigiraf next turn to prevent Trick Room after Taunt expires.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Mamoswine HH KOs Incineroar T3 (guaranteed). Switched Gengar→Gyarados to preserve Shadow Tag user for re-entry. Farigiraf Taunt expires after T3; Gyarados (Spe 130>Farigiraf 80-112) must re-Taunt to stop Trick Room. Gengar can switch back in later to re-trap. Opponent backline threats: Sneasler 154-189 Spe (Unburden 2x after Focus Sash), Gardevoir-Mega 120-152 Spe (Pixilate), Dedenne 133-168 (CheekPouch), Skarmory 90-122 (Sturdy/OccaBerry). Corviknight Tailwind for speed control. Mamoswine Focus Sash intact; Ice Shard priority vs Sneasler. Sludge Bomb does 37-84.6% to Farigiraf; Psychic does 75.9-137.2% to Gengar (61% OHKO chance).

decisions.rationale: Gengar-Mega's Shadow Tag traps both our actives, so Incineroar cannot Parting Shot out. Mamoswine (faster) High Horsepower KOs Incineroar from 43% before it acts, so its move is a contingency: Will-O-Wisp on Mamoswine cripples it if Incineroar survives. Farigiraf is Taunted (no TR/Protect) but safe at full HP; Psychic on Gengar-Mega is 2x and can OHKO, softening the main threat for the turn-4 Trick Room.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega (Timid, Gengarite) Megas to Shadow Tag + Taunt; Shadow Tag traps our actives so Parting Shot/U-turn/switch are blocked while it's on field. Farigiraf was Taunted turn 1, so Trick Room/Protect unavailable through turn 3; TR available turn 4. Mamoswine Adamant ThickFat FocusSash IceShard/IcicleCrash/HighHorsepower/Protect; its Ice Shard nullified by Armor Tail while Farigiraf active. Farigiraf Psychic is 2x on Gengar-Mega (possible OHKO); Hyper Voice weak on Mamoswine. Gardevoir Moonblast/Psyshock 2x on Gengar; Sneasler Rock Slide answers Gyarados; Close Combat immune vs Gengar. Bench: Gyarados Jolly Intimidate Sitrus, Skeledirge Modest Unaware Lum, Corviknight MirrorArmor Leftovers, Klefki Prankster LightClay screens/TW. Plan: set TR turn 4 with Farigiraf, use Gardevoir to answer Gengar, keep Farigiraf alive.

decisions.rationale: Bring Gardevoir to Mega Evolve: Psyshock is 2x on Gengar-Mega (possible OHKO) and it survives Gyarados Crunch (21.7-52.4%) and Mamoswine's neutral hits, while Moonblast threatens the 58% Gyarados. Gardevoir synergizes with Farigiraf's Trick Room (slower), whereas Sneasler is fast (bad under TR) and 2x-weak to Mamoswine's High Horsepower. Farigiraf passes to set TR next turn.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega (Timid, Gengarite) Mega→Shadow Tag + Taunt; traps our actives while on field. Farigiraf's Taunt wore off; Trick Room available. Mamoswine Adamant ThickFat FocusSash (IceShard/IcicleCrash/HighHorsepower/Protect); Ice Shard nullified by Armor Tail while Farigiraf active. Gyarados Jolly Intimidate Sitrus (Waterfall/Taunt/Crunch/Protect); Crunch 2x on Farigiraf (survives w/ Sitrus) and on Gardevoir-Mega (not OHKO). Gardevoir-Mega Psyshock 2x on Gengar-Mega (possible OHKO); Moonblast threatens Gyarados; survives Gyarados Crunch; Mamoswine's moves neutral on it. Sneasler Jolly FocusSash Unburden; Close Combat 2x Mamoswine (sash survives); 2x-weak to Mamoswine High Horsepower (sash saves); bad under TR. Plan: Farigiraf sets TR, Mega Gardevoir answers Gengar; keep Farigiraf alive.

decisions.rationale: Switch Mamoswine→Gengar-Mega for Shadow Tag trap; Gyarados Taunts Farigiraf to stop Trick Room (130>112). Gengar resists Moonblast/Hyper Voice (NFE 0.5x via Poison), only Psyshock SE but unlikely chosen vs Mamoswine. Next turn Gengar 200 Spe Sludge Bombs Gardevoir-Mega (SE 2x, 49-148%, possible OHKO). Mamoswine preserved 100% Focus Sash for Sneasler.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 T4: Switched Mamo→Gengar-Mega (Shadow Tag trap both foes). Gyarados Taunts Farigiraf (130>112, stops TR). Gengar resists Fairy (NFE 0.5x Poison), only Psyshock SE (62-210%, possible OHKO). Next: Gengar 200 Spe Sludge Bomb Gardevoir-Mega = SE 2x 49-148% possible OHKO. Mamo preserved 100% Focus Sash for Sneasler (Ice Shard priority). Gyarados Hyper Voice max 55.7% from 58% = survives + Sitrus. Moonblast vs Gyarados 38.7-64.9% = possible KO from 58%. Corviknight resists all Gardevoir moves (Steel NFE 0.5x) as safe alt switch. Opponent backline: Sneasler 154-189 Unburden 2x after Sash, Dedenne 133-168 CheekPouch, Skarmory 90-122 Sturdy/Occa.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Gardevoir)
decisions.rationale: Set Trick Room with Farigiraf to make Gengar-Mega (Shadow Tag, fast Sludge Bomb) move last, while Gardevoir Mega Evolves and Hyper Voices both foes to pressure Gyarados (58%) and chip Mamoswine. If Gyarados Protects, Hyper Voice still hits Mamoswine. TR is key to handling Gengar's speed; Farigiraf likely survives since Gyarados may Protect at 58%.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega (Timid, Gengarite) Mega→Shadow Tag + Taunt; Sludge Bomb 2x on Gardevoir-Mega (84-139%, possible OHKO); Psyshock 2x on Gengar (possible OHKO). Mamoswine Adamant ThickFat FocusSash (IceShard/IcicleCrash/HighHorsepower/Protect); Ice Shard nullified by Armor Tail while Farigiraf active. Gyarados Jolly Intimidate Sitrus (Waterfall/Taunt/Crunch/Protect); Crunch 2x on Farigiraf (survives w/ Sitrus); Waterfall 44-78% on Gardevoir. Gardevoir-Mega Hyper Voice (Pixilate) 32-69% on Gyarados, 40-96% on Mamoswine; Moonblast 37-82% on Gyarados; Farigiraf Hyper Voice 19-40% Gyarados/23-55% Mamoswine, Psychic 25-54% Gyarados. Plan: TR to slow Gengar; keep Farigiraf alive (Armor Tail blocks priority). Under TR order: Farigiraf(80) first, then Mamoswine/Gyarados, then Gardevoir(120), Gengar last.

decisions.rationale: Both foes' Psychic moves (Psyshock 135-185%, Psychic 93-137%) guaranteed KO Gengar at 62%. Opponent is Shadow Tag-trapped and must KO Gengar to escape, so they'll likely double-target it. Gengar Protect blocks both, wasting their turn. Gyarados outspeeds Farigiraf (130>112) and Crunches for SE 37-70%, setting up a KO next turn. Once Farigiraf falls, Gengar is safe to Sludge Bomb Gardevoir. If opp predicts Protect and hits Gyarados, Gengar survives with Shadow Tag and Mamoswine enters at 100%.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 key facts: Gardevoir-Mega Psyshock = guaranteed OHKO on Gengar at 62% (135-185%). Farigiraf Psychic = guaranteed OHKO on Gengar at 62% (93-137%). Gengar Sludge Bomb on Gardevoir = 69.7-121.7% (possible OHKO). Gyarados Crunch on Farigiraf = 37-69.7% SE. Gardevoir Hyper Voice spread on Gyarados = 16-34.5% (possible KO at 30%). Gyarados 130 Spe vs Gardevoir 120-152 = uncertain speed order. Plan: Protect Gengar to block guaranteed KOs while Gyarados Crunches Farigiraf twice to eliminate the Psychic threat, then Gengar can safely attack Gardevoir. Farigiraf is Taunted (can only Hyper Voice/Psychic) and trapped by Shadow Tag. Mamoswine 100% Focus Sash preserved for Sneasler (Ice Shard priority). Corviknight 100% walls both active foes (resists all Gardevoir moves). Opponent backline: Sneasler 154-189 Unburden 2x after Sash, Dedenne 133-168 CheekPouch, Skarmory 90-122 Sturdy/Occa.

decisions.rationale: Gengar-Mega is fastest and can OHKO Gardevoir (Sludge Bomb 73-122%, Shadow Ball 65-108%). Protect Gardevoir to survive its attack while Farigiraf (Taunted, must attack) hits Gengar with 2x Psychic (~62-144%, borderline KO at its 62% HP). This preserves our main damage dealer and pressures the biggest threat; Gyarados (29%) can't OHKO either mon.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega (Timid, Gengarite) Mega→Shadow Tag + Taunt. Sludge Bomb 2x on Gardevoir-Mega 73-122% (possible OHKO); Shadow Ball 65-108% (possible OHKO). Gardevoir Psyshock 2x on Gengar ~90-210% (likely OHKO); Farigiraf Psychic on Gengar ~62-144% (borderline KO at 62% HP). Gyarados Jolly Intimidate, Sitrus consumed; Waterfall 44-78% on Gardevoir, Crunch 35-62% on Farigiraf; Moonblast on Gyarados 38-83%. Mamoswine Adamant ThickFat FocusSash (IceShard/IcicleCrash/HighHorsepower/Protect); Ice Shard nullified by Armor Tail while Farigiraf active. Farigiraf Taunt blocks status moves; Armor Tail blocks priority. Gardevoir-Mega Hyper Voice is Normal-typed per chart (Pixilate may convert to Fairy—verify before relying on it vs Gengar). Plan: preserve Gardevoir, remove Gengar (Shadow Tag) via Farigiraf Psychic while Gardevoir Protects; then clean Gyarados and slower bench.

decisions.rationale: Gengar at 62% is OHKO'd by both foes' Psychic/Psyshock; Protect is unreliable (used last turn). Switch to Corviknight who resists all 4 active moves (max ~33% each). If foes double-targeted Gengar's slot, Corviknight eats resisted hits. Gyarados Crunches Farigiraf (Def-1) for 50-115% — possible KO, minimum leaves it at ~24%. Preserves Gengar for re-entry with Shadow Tag later.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 key facts: Gardevoir-Mega Psyshock = guaranteed OHKO on Gengar at 62%. Farigiraf Psychic = guaranteed OHKO on Gengar at 62%. Gengar Sludge Bomb on Gardevoir = 69.7-121.7% (possible OHKO). Gyarados Crunch on Farigiraf (Def -1) = 50.2-114.9% (possible KO from 74%). Corviknight resists ALL Gardevoir moves (Psyshock 10-33%, Moonblast resisted, Hyper Voice resisted) and ALL Farigiraf moves (Psychic 10-33%, Hyper Voice resisted). Corviknight 100% is a full wall to both active foes. Mamoswine 100% Focus Sash preserved for Sneasler (Ice Shard priority). Opponent backline: Sneasler 154-189 Unburden 2x after Sash, Dedenne 133-168 CheekPouch, Skarmory 90-122 Sturdy/Occa. Gyarados Sitrus consumed, at 30%. Plan: preserve Gengar, use Corviknight to wall, bring Gengar back to re-trap when safe. Gyarados 130 Spe vs Gardevoir 120-152 = uncertain speed order.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Gengar (Shadow Tag) is the priority threat and faster than both our mons, so Gardevoir Protects to guarantee survival against its possible Sludge Bomb OHKO. Farigiraf (Taunted, can only attack) Psychics Gengar for a borderline KO at 62% HP. Risk is Gyarados Crunch KOing Farigiraf (def -1), but keeping Gardevoir alive is our win condition; if Farigiraf survives, Gengar falls and we clean Gyarados + bench.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega Timid Gengarite: Mega->Shadow Tag + Taunt. Sludge Bomb 2x on Gardevoir-Mega 49-148% (possible OHKO); Shadow Ball 2x 65-108%. Gardevoir Psyshock 2x on Gengar 62-210% (likely OHKO). Farigiraf Psychic 2x on Gengar 44-155% (borderline at 62%). Gyarados Jolly Intimidate, Sitrus consumed; Crunch on Farigiraf (def -1) 39-131% possible KO; Waterfall 44-78% on Gardevoir; Moonblast on Gyarados 38-83%. Mamoswine Adamant ThickFat FocusSash (IceShard/IcicleCrash/HighHorsepower/Protect); Ice Shard nullified by Armor Tail while Farigiraf active. Farigiraf Taunt blocks status; Armor Tail blocks priority. Gardevoir-Mega Hyper Voice is Normal-typed per chart (Pixilate may convert to Fairy—verify before relying vs Gengar). Plan: remove Gengar (Shadow Tag) via Farigiraf Psychic while Gardevoir Protects; then clean Gyarados and slower bench (Mamoswine/Corviknight/Klefki/Skeledirge).

decisions.rationale: Corviknight U-turn KOs 4% Farigiraf (31.7% min > 4%) and pivots to Gengar-Mega for Shadow Tag, trapping Gardevoir. Gyarados must Protect—Gardevoir Psyshock/Moonblast both KO at 30% (39% min). Next turn Gengar (200 Spe) outspeeds Gardevoir (120-152) and Shadow Ball has possible OHKO (51-109%).
decisions.notebook: Gengar Shadow Ball on Gardevoir-Mega = 51.4-109.1% (possible OHKO, SE Ghost vs Psychic). Gengar Sludge Bomb on Gardevoir = 69.7-121.7% (possible OHKO). Gengar 200 Spe outspeeds Gardevoir 120-152, Sneasler 154-189 (pre-Unburden), Dedenne 133-168. Shadow Tag traps active foes when Gengar is on field. Mamoswine Focus Sash preserved for Sneasler (Ice Shard priority). Opponent backline: Sneasler FocusSash Unburden 154-189 (2x after Sash break), Dedenne OranBerry CheekPouch 133-168, Skarmory OccaBerry Sturdy 90-122. Plan: trap Gardevoir with Shadow Tag, KO with Gengar Shadow Ball, then manage backline with Mamoswine priority and Gyarados Taunt/Crunch support.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf at 5% is KO'd by Gyarados Crunch or Corviknight U-turn; Protect blocks both, keeps Armor Tail, and stops Corviknight from U-turning into Gengar. Gardevoir Psyshocks Gyarados (40-76% > 29% HP, KO) and, if Gyarados switches to Gengar, Psyshock reliably KOs it (98-188% vs 62%), neutralizing the Shadow Tag Sludge Bomb that could OHKO Gardevoir.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega Timid Gengarite: Shadow Tag + Taunt. Sludge Bomb 2x on Gardevoir-Mega 80-111% (possible OHKO); Gardevoir Psyshock 2x on Gengar 98-188% (reliable KO). Hyper Voice is Fairy via Pixilate (1.2x, spread 0.75x); vs Gengar 0.5x (21-41%), vs Corviknight 0.5x (17-32%), vs Gyarados 1x (35-63%). Moonblast on Gyarados 41-74%; Psyshock on Gyarados 40-76% (both KO at 29%). Corviknight Brave Bird on Gardevoir 54-84%. Farigiraf Psychic on Gyarados 27-49% (borderline KO at 29%). Mamoswine Adamant ThickFat FocusSash (IceShard/IcicleCrash/HighHorsepower/Protect); Ice Shard blocked by Armor Tail while Farigiraf alive. Plan: keep Gardevoir alive, remove Gengar via Psyshock when it enters, then clean Gyarados/Corviknight/Mamoswine; Sneasler (Jolly 189, FocusSash, Unburden) is the fast closer but Throat Chop is its only move that hits Gengar.

decisions.rationale: U-turn into Gardevoir guarantees Gengar-Mega enters after Gardevoir acts (Gardevoir outspeeds Corviknight 120-152 vs 95), so Gengar avoids Psyshock KO. Shadow Tag then traps Gardevoir. Gyarados Crunch KOs Farigiraf (4% HP, SE guaranteed). Even if Gardevoir KOs Gyarados first, Gengar still enters safely and traps Gardevoir for next-turn Shadow Ball (51-109% range).
decisions.notebook: Gardevoir-Mega Psyshock KOs Gengar-Mega at 62% (76.6-210.4%, SE Psychic vs Poison). Moonblast does NOT KO Gengar (19.8-54.1%, NVE Fairy vs Poison). Gengar must enter via U-turn after Gardevoir acts, never direct switch. Gengar Shadow Ball on Gardevoir = 51.4-109.1% (possible OHKO). Gengar 200 Spe outspeeds Gardevoir 120-152, Sneasler 154-189 pre-Unburden, Dedenne 133-168. Shadow Tag traps all foe species (none Ghost-type). Mamoswine Focus Sash preserved for Sneasler (Ice Shard priority). Opponent backline: Sneasler FSash Unburden 154-189 (2x after Sash break), Dedenne OranBerry CheekPouch 133-168, Skarmory OccaBerry Sturdy 90-122. Plan: trap Gardevoir with Shadow Tag, KO with Gengar Shadow Ball, then manage backline with Mamoswine priority and Gyarados/CORVI support.

decisions.rationale: Bring Gengar-Mega into slot a and Mamoswine into slot b. Gengar is immune to Sneasler's Close Combat (Ghost typing). Next turn: double-target Gardevoir with Shadow Ball+Ice Shard for guaranteed KO, then priority Ice Shard cleans up Sneasler at 1HP after Sash break. Shadow Tag traps both foes. Farigiraf at 4% is trivial cleanup.
decisions.notebook: Sneasler Close Combat IMMUNE vs Gengar-Mega (Fighting vs Ghost 0x). Sneasler Throat Chop SE vs Gengar (Dark vs Ghost 2x, 33.5-118.5% possible OHKO at 62%). Sneasler Rock Slide vs Gengar 12-41.5% spread neutral, not a KO threat. Mamoswine Ice Shard vs Sneasler 13.4-48.4% neutral, breaks Sash. Sneasler Close Combat vs Mamoswine 59-192.4% SE, Sash saves at 1HP. Gengar Shadow Ball vs Gardevoir 44.6-131.5% SE possible OHKO. Ice Shard priority +1 KOs Sneasler at 1HP regardless of Unburden speed. Shadow Tag traps Sneasler+Gardevoir (neither Ghost). Plan: double-target Gardevoir (Shadow Ball+Ice Shard) to ensure KO, then priority Ice Shard picks off Sneasler at 1HP post-Sash, then Farigiraf 4% trivial. Gengar 200 Spe outspeeds Gardevoir 120-152 and Sneasler 154-189 pre-Unburden. If Sneasler Sash broken, Unburden makes it 308-378 (faster than Gengar) but priority Ice Shard still outspeeds. Opponent backline Farigiraf 4% HP Sitrus consumed.

decisions.rationale: Bring Mamoswine—only Ice Shard priority answers Unburden Sneasler. Plan: Gengar Shadow Ball into Gardevoir (61.7-109.1%, likely KO at 78%), Mamoswine High Horsepower into Sneasler (84.5-205.2%, breaks Sash→Unburden). Sneasler outspeeds Mamoswine but CC won't KO through Focus Sash. Next turn Ice Shard KOs Sneasler at 1HP regardless of 308-378 Unburden speed. Shadow Tag traps both foes. Corviknight lacks priority and can't handle Unburden.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega Shadow Ball vs Gardevoir-Mega: 61.7-109.1% (likely KO at 78% HP, not guaranteed). Mamoswine Ice Shard vs Sneasler: 17.6-44.5% (cannot break Sash from full). Mamoswine High Horsepower vs Sneasler: 84.5-205.2% (breaks Sash, triggers Unburden 308-378 Spe). Sneasler Close Combat vs Mamoswine: 71.9-158.9% (Mamoswine survives via Sash or tanks). Gengar 200 Spe outspeeds Sneasler 154-189 pre-Unburden and Gardevoir 120-152. Shadow Tag traps both active foes (neither Ghost). Priority Ice Shard is the ONLY answer to Unburden Sneasler on this team. Plan: double-target (Shadow Ball→Gardevoir, High Horsepower→Sneasler), then Ice Shard KOs Sneasler at 1HP next turn. Farigiraf 4% in back is trivial cleanup. Corviknight 74% available as backup if needed. Sneasler Throat Chop SE vs Gengar (Dark vs Ghost 2x) is the main threat to Gengar at 62%.

decisions.rationale: Hyper Voice (Fairy/Pixilate) KOs Gyarados at 29% (32.7-69.4%) and chips Corviknight (17.6-39.3%). Switch the 5% Farigiraf to Sneasler to bring in the fast FocusSash closer; Sneasler Throat Chop hits Gengar-Mega for 33.5-118.5% (possible OHKO), covering the Gengar switch-in threat. Accept modest risk to Gardevoir from a possible Gengar Sludge Bomb or Gyarados outspeeding, since Sneasler provides a fallback answer to Gengar.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega Timid Gengarite: Shadow Tag + Taunt. Sludge Bomb 2x on Gardevoir-Mega 80-111% (possible OHKO); Gardevoir Psyshock 2x on Gengar 98-188% (reliable KO). Gardevoir Hyper Voice is Fairy via Pixilate (1.2x, spread 0.75x): vs Gengar 0.5x (21-41%), vs Corviknight 0.5x (17.6-39.3%), vs Gyarados 1x (32.7-69.4%). Moonblast on Gyarados 41-74%; Psyshock on Gyarados 40-76%. Corviknight Brave Bird on Gardevoir 54-84%; Gyarados Waterfall on Gardevoir 43.9-78.3%. Sneasler Jolly 189 FocusSash Unburden; Throat Chop on Gengar-Mega 33.5-118.5% (possible OHKO). Mamoswine Adamant ThickFat FocusSash (IceShard/IcicleCrash/HighHorsepower/Protect); Ice Shard blocked by Armor Tail while Farigiraf alive. Plan: keep Gardevoir alive, remove Gengar via Psyshock or Sneasler Throat Chop, then clean Gyarados/Corviknight/Mamoswine with Sneasler as fast closer. Trick Room is bad for my fast team (Gardevoir 140, Sneasler 189) — avoid setting it.

decisions.rationale: Sludge Bomb (90 BP, 2x SE) has ~79% KO on Gardevoir at 78% vs Shadow Ball's ~69%, removing the Psyshock threat (guaranteed KO on Gengar at 62%). HHP breaks Sneasler's Sash 95%+ (or leaves <7% HP), guaranteeing Ice Shard KO next turn. Even if Gardevoir survives and KOs Gengar, position stays winning with Mamoswine+Corviknight vs low-HP Gardevoir+4% Farigiraf.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega exact SpA 222, Spe 200. Sludge Bomb vs Gardevoir-Mega: 62.9-135.7% (79% KO at 78%). Shadow Ball vs Gardevoir: 58.3-121.7% (69% KO). HHP vs Sneasler (Mamoswine Atk 200): 93-228.4% (95%+ breaks Sash). Gardevoir Psyshock vs Gengar: 62.3% min — guaranteed KO at 62% HP. Sneasler Throat Chop vs Gengar: 33.5-118.5% (~66% KO at 62%). Sneasler CC vs Mamoswine: 59-192.4%. Sneasler outspeeds Mamoswine (154-189 vs 132). Ice Shard priority +1 is only Unburden answer. Farigiraf 4% in back is trivial. Corviknight 74% backup. Plan: Sludge Bomb+HHP this turn, Ice Shard cleanup next turn. Game 2 win likely leads to game 3 decider.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Gengar-Mega outspeeds Gardevoir and Sludge Bomb/Shadow Ball can KO it (72-122%), so Protect Gardevoir to keep it alive. Sneasler Throat Chop on Gengar (47-108% vs its 62% HP) has a strong chance to remove the Shadow Tag threat; Mamoswine's High Horsepower OHKOs Sneasler but FocusSash saves it and triggers Unburden. If Gengar survives, finish it next turn while Gardevoir stays healthy.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega Timid Gengarite Shadow Tag; faster than Gardevoir (165-200 vs 140); Sludge Bomb 72-122% and Shadow Ball 65-108% on Gardevoir-Mega (both possible OHKO at 78%). Gardevoir Psyshock reliably KOs Gengar (90-210%). Sneasler Throat Chop on Gengar 47-108% (~75% KO at 62% HP). Mamoswine Adamant ThickFat FocusSash; High Horsepower OHKOs Sneasler (116-202%) but sash saves at 1 HP and triggers Unburden; Ice Shard blocked by Armor Tail only while Farigiraf alive. Corviknight MirrorArmor Leftovers, Brave Bird on Gardevoir 54-84%. Plan: remove Gengar to escape Shadow Tag, keep Gardevoir alive, use Unburden Sneasler as fast closer vs Mamoswine/Corviknight. Avoid setting Trick Room (my team is fast).

decisions.rationale: Ice Shard (+1 priority) KO's Sneasler at 1% before it can act (only Protect +4 blocks it). Tailwind guarantees both Corviknight (190) and Mamoswine (264) outspeed Gardevoir (120-152) and Farigiraf (4%) next turn, securing the 2v1 endgame and the series 2-0. Mamoswine survives any Gardevoir hit at 100%+Focus Sash. If Sneasler Protects, it's still 1% next turn and Ice Shard kills it then.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 endgame plan: Tailwind+Ice Shard on Sneasler(1%). Sneasler Unburden 308-378 but Ice Shard priority+1 beats all non-Protect moves. Gardevoir-Mega 120-152 Spe, all attacks NVE vs Corviknight(0.5x). Farigiraf 4% trivial. With Tailwind up: Corvi 190, Mamo 264 outspeed everything remaining. Mamoswine Focus Sash intact at 100%. Win this game = series 2-0. If game 3 needed: opponent full team is Incineroar/Gardevoir-Mega/Sneasler/Farigiraf/Dedenne/Skarmory. Gengar-Mega Spe 200, SpA 222. Gyarados fainted. Key damage notes: HHP vs Sneasler 93-228% (95%+ breaks Sash). Sneasler CC vs Mamo 59-192%. Gardevoir Psyshock vs Gengar 62.3% min guaranteed KO.

decisions.rationale: Sneasler Close Combat breaks Mamoswine's Focus Sash (2x, 78-175%); Gardevoir's spread Hyper Voice finishes Mamoswine (22-53%) while chipping Corviknight. This removes the threat that KOs Sneasler and gives Sneasler a chance to survive and hit Corviknight (Close Combat is 1x, 35-75%) next turn for a real win path. Leaving Mamoswine alive is worse since its High Horsepower can OHKO Gardevoir (33-117%).
decisions.notebook: Corviknight: Flying/Steel, MirrorArmor, Leftovers, Careful. All Gardevoir moves (Normal/Fairy/Psychic) are resisted by Steel/Flying, so Gardevoir alone cannot break it; Sneasler must handle it. Sneasler Close Combat on Corviknight is net 1x (Fighting 2x vs Steel, 0.5x vs Flying) dealing 35-75%; Throat Chop 1x 16-34%; Rock Slide 1x 10-23%. Brave Bird has recoil and can OHKO Gardevoir (29-112%) or Sneasler. Mamoswine: Adamant ThickFat FocusSash, High Horsepower 2x on Sneasler and 33-117% on Gardevoir; must be removed via sash-break + follow-up. Sneasler Unburden makes it fastest (378). Gengar-Mega gone. Plan: keep Sneasler alive to Close Combat Corviknight; Gardevoir chips with Hyper Voice. Avoid Trick Room (my team is fast).

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Mamoswine Ice Shard (pri +1) KOs 4% Farigiraf before Trick Room (pri -7) can go up. Corviknight Brave Bird chunks Gardevoir 36-71%, leaving it at ~7-42%. Gardevoir's Hyper Voice does only 9-13% to Corviknight (NVE+spread). Next turn Corviknight outspeeds under Tailwind and finishes the 1v1 easily. This wins game 2 and the series 2-0.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 won 2-0. Series complete. If game 3 ever needed: opponent full team Incineroar/Gardevoir-Mega/Sneasler/Farigiraf/Dedenne/Skarmory. This is the most robust line against the likely split (Mamoswine->Farigiraf, Corviknight->Gardevoir), keeping both alive and removing the immediate threat.

decisions.rationale: Brave Bird KOs Gardevoir-Mega (34-67% vs 13% HP). Recoil is minimal (~7 HP from actual damage dealt). Corviknight survives at ~20% and easily cleans up 4% Farigiraf next turn — all its attacks are NVE vs Corviknight. Tailwind ensures we outspeed both foes. Guaranteed win.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 won. Series complete 2-0. Opponent full team: Incineroar/Gardevoir-Mega/Sneasler/Farigiraf/Dedenne/Skarmory. Key facts: Gardevoir-Mega all attacks NVE vs Corviknight (0.5x). Hyper Voice spread ~9-13% to Corvi. Corvi Brave Bird 34-67% to Gardevoir-Mega. Farigiraf ArmorTail blocks priority. Sneasler Unburden doubles Speed after item consumption. Mamoswine Focus Sash breaks to any hit. Ice Shard priority +1 beats Trick Room priority -7. Farigiraf Protect success rate drops after 2 uses. Corviknight Mirror Armor reflects Intimidate. Gyarados Intimidate + Taunt useful vs setup. Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag traps but is frail to Sneasler Throat Chop.

decisions.rationale: Corviknight is the last foe at 23% and outruns both of us under Tailwind; its Brave Bird KOs either of my low-HP mons. It will rationally target the bigger threat, Gardevoir. So Gardevoir Protects to absorb that hit while Farigiraf chips Corviknight with Psychic (single-target, avoiding self-damage from spread Hyper Voice), then Farigiraf finishes next turn. This maximizes win odds in the likely branch.
decisions.notebook: Corviknight: Flying/Steel, MirrorArmor, Leftovers, Careful; resists all my Normal/Fairy/Psychic moves; its Brave Bird KOs my low-HP mons and it outruns me under Tailwind. It is the last remaining foe this game (Klefki+Skeledirge not brought). My remaining pieces are Gardevoir-Mega and Farigiraf; both are frail and Corviknight's Brave Bird OHKOs either at low HP. Gardevoir is the higher-damage threat (Moonblast ~90% KO from 23% Corviknight) so Corviknight prefers targeting it; Farigiraf Psychic is ~45% KO. Spread Hyper Voice hits my own ally, so single-target moves are required when allies are low. Avoid Trick Room (my team is fast). Future: if Corviknight survives, it heals via Leftovers and outruns me until Tailwind expires.

decisions.rationale: U-turn KOs Gardevoir (14.3-28% > 13% HP) with no recoil, preserving my 25 HP. Farigiraf's best attacks do 12.7-19% (24-36 HP) — I survive at min roll. KOing Farigiraf instead leaves Gardevoir who can Moonblast (19-27%) for guaranteed KO. Brave Bird recoil makes survival impossible. Protect/Tailwind delays but both foes KO me next turn combined. U-turn Gardevoir is the only line with any survival chance.

Gardevoir Moonblast (min 20.5%) and Farigiraf Psychic (min 13.7%) both exceed 12%, so whichever mon survives KOs Corviknight. Even if Corviknight Protects, it heals to ~18%, Tailwind expires, and Gardevoir outruns and KOs next turn. Attacking with both is safe and wins now.
decisions.notebook: Corviknight: Flying/Steel, MirrorArmor, Leftovers, Careful; resists my Normal/Fairy/Psychic moves; Brave Bird OHKOs my frail mons and outruns them under Tailwind. It is the last remaining foe this game (Klefki+Skeledirge not brought). My remaining pieces are Gardevoir-Mega and Farigiraf; both frail. Gardevoir Moonblast min 20.5% and Farigiraf Psychic min 13.7% of Corviknight's max HP, so either KOs it at ~12% or below; Gardevoir is the higher-damage threat and Corviknight prefers targeting it. reflections.summary: Gengar-Mega contributed little before falling to Sneasler's Throat Chop on turn 9, leaving the team without enough firepower. The endgame then hinged on Farigiraf surviving at 4% because Armor Tail blocked Mamoswine's Ice Shard, forcing Corviknight to choose between KOing Gardevoir or Farigiraf—it could not do both, and fell to Psychic after U-turning Gardevoir.
reflections.adjustment: Reconsider the Gengar-Mega bring: it is too frail versus Sneasler and provides no answer to Armor Tail Farigiraf. For game 3, either lead Gengar more carefully to get value before Sneasler acts, or drop it for a slot that can outspeed and KO Farigiraf without relying on priority. Ensure a non-priority answer to Farigiraf exists on the field.
reflections.notebook: Opponent full team: Incineroar(Adamant/Leftovers/Intimidate, Fake Out/Parting Shot/Flare Blitz/WoW, Spe 80-112), Gardevoir-Mega(Modest/Gardevoirite, Hyper Voice/Moonblast/Psyshock/Protect, Spe 120-152, all attacks NVE 0.5x vs Corviknight), Sneasler(Jolly/Focus Sash/Unburden, Close Combat/Throat Chop/Rock Slide/Protect, Spe 154-189 doubles after item consumed), Farigiraf(Modest/Sitrus Berry/Armor Tail, Trick Room/Hyper Voice/Psychic/Protect, Spe 80-112, Armor Tail blocks priority), Dedenne(Timid/Oran Berry/Cheek Pouch, Nuzzle/Tbolt/Volt Switch/Protect, Spe 133-168, NOT brought g2), Skarmory(Impish/Occa Berry/Sturdy, Tailwind/Brave Bird/Body Press/Roost, Spe 90-122, NOT brought g2). Key: Corviknight Mirror Armor reflects Intimidate. Ice Shard +1 prio beats Trick Room -7 but Armor Tail blocks priority. Gengar-Mega frail to Sneasler Throat Chop. Gyarados Intimidate+Taunt vs setup. Mamoswine Sash breaks to any hit. Farigiraf Protect drops after 2 uses; Gardevoir after 4. Armor Tail on Farigiraf was decisive in g2—Mamoswine Ice Shard could not finish 4% Farigiraf, costing the endgame. Gengar-Mega underperformed vs Sneasler-heavy teams; consider alternative Mega or bring for g3. For g3: expect Dedenne/Skarmory may appear; Dedenne Cheek Pouch heals on Berry consumption; Skarmory Sturdy prevents OHKO. Need non-priority speed control or KO option for Farigiraf.

reflections.summary: Won because Farigiraf was preserved as the Corviknight answer and landed the final Psychic after Corviknight used U-turn into Gardevoir instead of finishing Farigiraf. The team preview was only partly suited: Sneasler and Farigiraf were the key checks, while Gardevoir-Mega was walled by Corviknight and its spread Hyper Voice risked hitting Farigiraf. Evolving Gardevoir committed to a matchup it could not break; the win came from opponent target choice and our Protect/switch preservation, not from the Mega plan.
reflections.adjustment: Next game, if Corviknight is expected, lead Farigiraf + Sneasler: Sneasler removes Gengar-Mega while Farigiraf chips Corviknight with Psychic. Keep Gardevoir-Mega in the back until Corviknight is gone, or consider not bringing it at all in favor of a Fire/Electric attacker. Use Protect on the Corviknight target to bait Brave Bird/U-turn, and avoid spread Hyper Voice when Farigiraf is low. Also prepare for Klefki/Skeledirge: Farigiraf's Armor Tail blocks Klefki's Prankster Thunder Wave, and Skeledirge needs a physical answer or Taunt.
reflections.notebook: Durable series notes: Opponent Corviknight is MirrorArmor/Leftovers/Careful, resists Normal/Fairy/Psychic, and uses Brave Bird, U-turn, Tailwind, Protect; under Tailwind it outspeeds and threatens frail mons, and U-turn is used to pivot and finish weakened targets. Opponent Mamoswine is Thick Fat/Focus Sash/Adamant; Ice Shard is priority and is blocked by Farigiraf's Armor Tail, while High Horsepower threatens Sneasler. Opponent Gengar-Mega is Timid with Sludge Bomb/Shadow Ball/Taunt/Protect; Sneasler Throat Chop OHKOs it. Opponent Gyarados is Intimidate/Sitrus/Jolly with Waterfall/Taunt/Crunch/Protect. Opponent left Klefki (Prankster screens/TWave) and Skeledirge (Unaware/Torch Song) out; expect them next game, and Armor Tail blocks Prankster priority. My team: Farigiraf is the reliable Corviknight answer with Psychic; Gardevoir-Mega is walled by Corviknight and its spread Hyper Voice hits allies, so use single-target moves when an ally is low. Future: preserve Farigiraf against Corviknight, use Protect to bait Brave Bird/U-turn, and consider not bringing Gardevoir-Mega if Corviknight is central.
